candidates.title: Business Lookup
candidates.description: The Business Lookup provides public information related to all current active accounts and five years of closed accounts for business licenses, excise tax accounts, and reseller permits issued by the Washington State Department of Revenue (DOR). It allows for search by business name, trade name, owners and officers, reseller permit number, unified business identifier (UBI), license number, street address, city, state, county, and endorsements issued through DOR's Business Licensing Service.
